name: AIPsychoBench
description: A benchmark tailored to assess the psychological properties of large language models using psychometric concepts adapted for LLMs. It improves response rates and reduces bias compared to traditional methods, and measures linguistic impacts across seven languages.
reputation: AIPsychoBench is a very recent benchmark and appears to be early-stage, with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Uses role-playing prompts to bypass alignment and measures psychometric variations across languages.
